native_source.contract: sRGB native formats convert sRGB bytes to linear-color floating shader values; this includes their read interpretation, not an Image upload transform

admission_routes.effect: No allocation or cached view, zero extent, default nominal format and empty usage. A descriptor can describe the nominal format but does not certify a usable view; later missing-state error remains authoritative.

Each nonempty allocation owner fixes usage once. STORAGE_BINDING requires supports_storage && !is_srgb. Allocation format is linear_counterpart, but cached view explicitly requests nominal format. Therefore nominal sRGB implies a nominal sRGB sampled view and no storage usage; nominal non-sRGB cached view is likewise nominal.

from_image chooses a format then create_from_image. Empty image returns Default; nonempty routes exclusively through create. Image::packed_for explicitly does not apply a transfer function, preserves eight-bit encoding (with BGRA reorder), and documents native sRGB conversion. No alternate Texture2d construction.

admission_routes.route: Texture2d color factories and arithmetic output factories
admission_routes.effect: from_color/create_from_color and add_raw/mix_raw all allocate through create and then perform operations; no alternate cached-format writer. Color clear/value semantics are separate from the admitted view identity.

Clone copies exact immutable metadata/Arc identity; GpuResource carries the whole value. clear_cached_view removes view; clear_native_texture removes allocation while leaving cached view; neither mutates nominal format/usage. native/cached getters expose immutable Arc references, not replacement of wrapper state. Native destroy/device loss can invalidate usability, not alter admitted format interpretation.

Returns another Arc view without replacing cached view or mutating metadata. On a linear allocation carrying storage usage, an explicit sRGB request may normalize to linear, but this does not change subsequent default sampling or descriptor-from-whole-resource identity.

from_resource takes GpuResource, which has only Buffer/whole Texture2d/whole Texture3d, never arbitrary TextureView. Sampled Naga image reflection leaves binding.format=None. Selection therefore requests texture.format(); cached nominal view is selected; returned native dimension/device are checked before use. Storage bindings instead carry Some(actual storage format) and can deliberately select a counterpart; this separate path must not be described as default sampling.

source_proofs.name: mutable format/usage reference or set mutation

typed_producer_implications: Carry existing TextureFormat from the canonical whole-resource producer. For a successfully bound default sampled whole texture, it identifies the selected view interpretation; no primitive string reclassification or extra stored flag is needed.

Do not globally rename nominal allocation metadata to universal effective format: allocation can be linear while its cached sampled view is sRGB; explicit alternate views and storage bindings have different selection contracts.

ResourceDescriptor variants and public build_pipeline APIs remain manually constructible. The proof covers descriptors actually produced from canonical whole resources, not a manually mismatched descriptor and pass parameter. Native layout/device/binding checks remain authoritative; a getter would not brand a manual descriptor to a resource.

Default/missing/cleared/error-handle states do not have a successfully usable sampled view merely because format() returns a value. Preserve existing MissingView/Uninitialized/WrongDevice and provider-handled validation policy.

No admitted nominal-sRGB plus STORAGE_BINDING whole texture was found. A future constructor/mutator changing that relationship must update the producer/selected-view contract then; inventing a hypothetical admission route is not a reason to add an API now.

findings.owner: #780 Advect/generated shader family; review only, no source edit
findings.scenario: Canonical execute receives a usable whole nominal-sRGB quantity Texture2d and a plain floating-point velocity Texture2d, with a native-valid floating output. The actual sampled quantity view is sRGB. Native loads already decode RGB into linear values, but sample_bilinear then applies another sRGB->linear transfer. That same quantity-controlled branch also transforms velocity when velocity is linear. Even dt==0 retains the quantity double decode; for nonzero dt the quantity encoding additionally changes the advection trajectory through velocity. This is source reasoning, not an authored/executed test case.
findings.proof: wgpu-types29.0.4 texture/format.rs183,193 states Rgba8UnormSrgb/Bgra8UnormSrgb are converted from sRGB bytes to linear-color float in shader. Actual cached/sample view contract and Image::packed_for prevent an unstated raw-byte interpretation here. Advect shared sample_bilinear(texture_2d<f32>) calls textureLoad, bilinearly mixes the fetched values, then conditionally applies the transfer using only the quantity descriptor; both velocity and quantity call it. The 3D branch directly textureLoads both resources and has no additional transform.
findings.minimum_connected_repair: #780 should remove or otherwise correct the second-decode/quantity-flag contract at the complete Advect generated shader owner, preserving native sampled-view semantics and existing interpolation/coordinate/dispatch/zero/format errors. No extra effective-format getter or alternative whole-resource descriptor owner is justified by this source. If a distinct raw-encoded source policy is intended, it requires an explicit actual producer/binding policy rather than applying the quantity flag to both resources.
acceptance: Nominal sRGB quantity is transformed once by its actual selected native sampled view.
Quantity encoding cannot cause an unrelated linear velocity texture to undergo a color transfer.
2D and3D successful loads follow their actual view encoding; interpolation/coordinate/numerical scheduling stays under the owner’s accepted contract.
Preserve descriptor/source/device/policy cache identity; classify the input at its true source with existing TextureFormat.
No new tests/cases/helpers/assertions/compatibility alias; only authorized existing checks at final integration.

limits: Read-only pinned source/Git and SDK documentation only; no source edits, local project checks/builds/scanners/tests/runtime/generators or new tests/cases/helpers/assertions.
Source searches are constrained Git provenance/admission inventories, not executed project scanners. Unsafe memory fabrication is outside admitted safe routes.
Native format behavior is supported by SDK source, not a runtime/GPU reproduction. No global GPU validity, browser synchronous validation or post-destroy usability guarantee.
Root47f is deliberately unintegrated with required canonical descriptor/caller migration. This contract does not imply compilation or final thirteen-lens/wholePR/hosted clearance.
